description: Defines the 'slot_point' class and related constants and functions for representing and manipulating slot points in a 5G NR radio frame, including wrap-around comparisons, conversions, and interval checks.

classes.name: slot_point
classes.description: Represents a specific slot in a 5G NR radio frame, including SFN, slot index, numerology, and provides methods for comparison, conversion, and interval checks.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Sets the slot_point to an invalid state.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the slot_point was correctly initialized.

methods.name: scs
methods.description: Returns the subcarrier spacing corresponding to the numerology.

methods.name: slot_index
methods.description: Returns the slot index within the radio frame.

methods.name: nof_slots_per_hyper_system_frame
methods.description: Returns total slots in a hyper system frame.

methods.name: nof_slots_per_subframe
methods.description: Returns number of slots in a subframe based on numerology.

methods.name: nof_slots_per_frame
methods.description: Returns total slots in a frame based on numerology.

methods.name: subframe_index
methods.description: Returns the subframe index within the radio frame.

methods.name: to_uint
methods.description: Returns the count value encoding SFN and slot index.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two slot_point objects.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Compares two slot_point objects accounting for wrap-around.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two slot_point objects.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds an integer or unsigned jump to the slot_point.

methods.name: is_in_interval
methods.description: Checks if the slot_point is within a specified interval.
